t: The Milwaukee Billet Torpedo Level is a compact and robust spirit level designed for precise levelling and measuring tasks on demanding job sites. Ideal for plumbers and electricians, it features a rigid aluminium profile and reinforced acrylic vials for long-lasting durability and accuracy. A V-groove magnetic base with amplified rare-earth magnets provides maximum holding power and stability on pipes and metal surfaces, while weld clearance enables accurate levelling over weld joints and uneven materials. The maximised viewing area allows for easy reading of slopes in ⅛" or ¼" per foot in either direction, and a laser-etched ruled edge enables quick material measurements. Its slim, tapered design slides easily into pockets and pouches for added jobsite convenience.
b: Amplified Rare-Earth Magnets for Maximum Holding Power
Maximised Viewing Area for Easy Slope Reading
